summary:
Canarias is an autonomous community of Spain and stands under the national framework on legal gender recognition and LGTBI rights; its own statutory layer is a regional non-discrimination and self-identification regime.

Ley 8/2014 of 28 October 2014, on non-discrimination on grounds of gender identity and recognition of trans persons' rights (BOE-A-2014-11995), gives a trans visitor to the islands a region-specific statutory basis against discriminatory treatment.

Canarias has allowed trans people to self-declare their legal gender since 2021, one of 14 autonomous communities to do so before the national statute of 28 February 2023 took effect.

The community is listed among those that ban conversion therapies, and it created a registry for same-sex couples in 2003, giving partners a regional recognition instrument.
tangentialFactors:
Gran Canaria and Tenerife are named internationally known destinations for LGBT travellers, which shapes the social environment a visitor meets on the two main islands.

Because the regional self-identification route dates from 2021 and the national statute from 2023, material published in that interval may describe Canarias as operating its own recognition procedure.
localsOnly:
Residents of the islands, not only visitors, fall under Ley 8/2014's non-discrimination guarantees and under the regional ban on conversion therapies.

The registry for same-sex couples created in 2003 is the community's own recognition instrument.

Residents had access to legal gender self-declaration at regional level from 2021, ahead of the national statute.
outOfScopeNotes:
The regional claims here rest on a single encyclopaedic source; no region-specific enforcement record, incident report, facility-access rule or screening practice for Canarias appears in the inventory.

The scope and penalties of the regional conversion-therapy ban are not detailed in the inventory, and whether the 2021 regional self-declaration route continues to operate as a distinct procedure alongside the national administrative route is not documented.
